description: This file defines the Control.Scale class for the Leaflet mapping library, implementing a scale control that displays metric and imperial distances on the map. It includes methods for creating, updating, and rendering scale bars based on map size and zoom level.

classes.name: Scale
classes.description: A control class extending Control that displays scale bars in metric and imperial units.

methods.name: onAdd
methods.description: Adds the scale control to the map, creates DOM elements, and sets up event listeners for map movements.

methods.name: onRemove
methods.description: Removes event listeners when the control is removed from the map.

methods.name: _addScales
methods.description: Creates scale DOM elements for metric and imperial units based on options.

methods.name: _update
methods.description: Calculates the maximum distance in meters based on map size and triggers scale updates.

methods.name: _updateScales
methods.description: Updates metric and imperial scales if enabled.

methods.name: _updateMetric
methods.description: Calculates and updates the metric scale bar.

methods.name: _updateImperial
methods.description: Calculates and updates the imperial scale bar.

methods.name: _updateScale
methods.description: Sets the width and label of a scale bar element.

methods.name: _getRoundNum
methods.description: Rounds a number to a 'nice' scale for display.
